name: Lima
tagline: Peru's sprawling coastal capital, a genuinely world-class food city where colonial grandeur sits above a pre-Inca pyramid still being excavated.

intro: Lima is genuinely Peru's sprawling coastal capital, a city where colonial-era grandeur in the historic centre sits alongside a food scene now regularly ranked among the best in the world.

It's also genuinely a city of real archaeological depth — Huaca Pucllana, a pre-Inca clay pyramid predating the Incas by centuries, still stands and is still being excavated in the middle of the modern Miraflores district.

Most visitors genuinely use Lima as their international gateway, spending a couple of days here before or after the Andes, though its food, museums and coastal neighbourhoods easily reward a dedicated stay of their own.

whyVisit.intro: Lima's case rests on genuinely world-class food layered over serious colonial and pre-Columbian history.

points.title: Huaca Pucllana predates the Inca genuinely by centuries

attractionsIntro: Lima's essential sights combine genuinely serious pre-Columbian and colonial history with its coastal modern neighbourhoods.

attractions.name: The Plaza Mayor

image.alt: The Plaza Mayor in central Lima

attractions.text: Genuinely the historic heart of the city, a grand colonial square surrounded by the cathedral, government palace and city hall.
attractions.tip: Genuinely time a visit for the changing of the guard at the Government Palace, held most days at noon.

attractions.name: Miraflores

image.alt: The modern skyline of Miraflores in Lima

attractions.text: Genuinely Lima's most polished district, a modern coastal neighbourhood of parks, shopping and some of the city's best restaurants.
attractions.tip: Genuinely a safe, walkable base for most visitors, especially first-timers to Lima.

attractions.name: The Bridge of Sighs, Barranco

image.alt: The Bridge of Sighs in the Barranco district of Lima

attractions.text: Genuinely a beloved local landmark, a small wooden footbridge at the heart of Lima's bohemian Barranco neighbourhood.
attractions.tip: Genuinely local legend says holding your breath while crossing brings good luck.

attractions.name: The Larco Museum

image.file: File:Seated Figure Bottle in Museo Larco - Lima.jpg
image.alt: Ancient ceramics at the Larco Museum in Lima

attractions.text: Genuinely one of Peru's finest museums, an extraordinary collection of pre-Columbian art housed in an 18th-century mansion.
attractions.tip: Genuinely the museum's gardens and on-site restaurant make it worth a leisurely half-day visit.

attractions.name: The Malecón de Miraflores

image.file: File:2017 Lima - El litoral limeño en el distrito de Miraflores.jpg
image.alt: The Malecón coastal walkway in Miraflores

attractions.text: Genuinely a striking coastal walkway running along cliffs above the Pacific, dotted with parks and paragliders overhead.
attractions.tip: Genuinely sunset here is one of Lima's best free experiences.

attractions.name: San Francisco Monastery

image.file: File:Peru Travel- Monastery of San Francisco, Lima.jpg
image.alt: The San Francisco Monastery in Lima

attractions.text: Genuinely a striking colonial monastery famous for its catacombs, where the bones of an estimated 25,000 people are arranged below ground.
attractions.tip: Genuinely the guided tour, included with entry, is essential for the full catacombs experience.

attractions.name: Huaca Pucllana

image.alt: The pre-Inca pyramid of Huaca Pucllana in Lima

attractions.text: Genuinely a pre-Inca clay and adobe pyramid, predating the Inca Empire by centuries, still actively excavated in the middle of Miraflores.
attractions.tip: Genuinely visit at dusk, when the site is lit up against the modern city skyline.

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely atmospheric, if slightly eerie, guided tour through underground burial chambers beneath the monastery.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely combine with a wander through the wider historic centre afterward.

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely striking contrast, an ancient clay pyramid lit up against Miraflores' modern skyline after dark.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely book the guided evening tour, which includes dramatic lighting of the site.

thingsToDo.title: Try Lima's world-class food scene
thingsToDo.text: A genuinely essential part of any Lima visit, from acclaimed fine dining to excellent, inexpensive local spots.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely book well-known restaurants weeks ahead — Lima's top tables are in serious demand.

bestTime.headline: December to April for the warmest, sunniest weather
bestTime.summary: Lima's coastal climate genuinely differs from the Andes, with a distinct grey, foggy winter season affecting visibility for months.

seasons.text: Genuinely the warmest, sunniest season, best for the Malecón and coastal neighbourhoods.
Genuinely mild with less fog than deep winter.
Genuinely grey and overcast, known locally as garúa, though rarely cold or rainy.

bestTime.avoid: Expecting sunny skies in Lima's winter — genuinely persistent coastal fog and cloud cover are the norm, June to September.

tipsIntro: Practical notes that make a Lima stay noticeably smoother.
tips: Book genuinely well-known restaurants weeks ahead — Lima's top tables are in serious demand.
Base yourself genuinely in Miraflores or Barranco rather than the historic centre for safety and convenience.
Budget genuinely extra time for taxi journeys — Lima's traffic is often heavy.
Check genuinely the forecast if visiting June–September — coastal fog is the seasonal norm, not a rare event.
Drink genuinely only bottled or purified water throughout your stay.
Combine genuinely Huaca Pucllana and the Larco Museum in one day, given their proximity.

faq.q: How many days do you need in Lima?
faq.a: Two to three days genuinely covers the historic centre, Miraflores and Barranco comfortably.

faq.q: Is Lima worth visiting beyond being a gateway city?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely — its food scene alone justifies dedicated time, alongside serious pre-Columbian and colonial history.
Generally yes in Miraflores and Barranco, with genuinely sensible precautions elsewhere, especially around petty theft in crowded areas.
Genuinely its world-class food scene, alongside colonial architecture and pre-Inca sites like Huaca Pucllana.
Genuinely a coastal phenomenon called garúa, caused by the cold Humboldt Current, persisting roughly June to September most years.

faq.q: Should I visit Lima before or after the Andes?
faq.a: Either works genuinely well — some visitors prefer Lima first to adjust before altitude, others end their trip here to enjoy the food scene at sea level.
